auth.users Supabase Auth
🔑 id UUID (PK)
⭐ email VARCHAR (UK)
encrypted_pw TEXT
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
public.profiles Core Users Table
🔑 id UUID (PK, FK)
⭐ username TEXT (UK, min 3)
email TEXT
full_name TEXT
phone_number TEXT
avatar_url TEXT
date_of_birth DATE
role user_role ENUM
status user_status ENUM
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
ON DELETE CASCADE with auth.users
public.categories Event Taxonomy
🔑 id UUID (PK)
name TEXT (NOT NULL)
⭐ slug TEXT (UK, NOT NULL)
pic TEXT (Cover URL)
small_description TEXT
icon TEXT (Lucide)
is_popular BOOL (Partial idx)
is_active BOOL (Partial idx)
display_order INTEGER
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
RLS: Admin Write Only (2MB Bucket)
public.subcategories Sub-Taxonomy
🔑 id UUID (PK)
🔗 category_id FK → categories(id)
name TEXT (NOT NULL)
⭐ slug TEXT (UK/cat, NOT NULL)
icon TEXT (Default 'Tag')
is_published BOOL (Partial idx)
display_order INTEGER (NOT NULL)
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
UNIQUE (category_id, slug) | CASCADE
organizer_permissions Scopes
🔑 id UUID (PK)
🔗 user_id FK → profiles(id)
section permission_section
access_level access_level ENUM
🔗 granted_by FK → profiles(id)
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
UNIQUE (user_id, section)
admin_audit_logs Audit Trail
🔑 id UUID (PK)
🔗 admin_id FK → profiles(id)
🔗 target_user_id FK (NULLABLE)
action TEXT
metadata JSONB
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
ON DELETE SET NULL on target_user
public.events [Planned]
🔑 id UUID (PK)
🔗 category_id FK → categories
🔗 organizer_id FK → profiles
title TEXT
⭐ slug TEXT (UK)
start_time TIMESTAMPTZ
status TEXT
Ready to connect when created
